name: ai-desk-card
title_zh: 桌上墨水屏卡片的专属遥控器，说句话它就换内容
tagline_zh: 不用掏手机、不用开电脑，对着空气说一句，540×960 的墨水屏立刻显示日程、提醒或任何你想瞄一眼的东西。
tagline_en: No phone, no laptop—just speak, and your 540×960 e-ink card updates with schedules, alerts, or anything.
desc_en: Drive a physical e-ink desk card (M5Paper 540×960) sitting next to the user's monitor. Use whenever the user wants to: - show / push / display ANYTHING on their card / 卡片 / 副屏 / 墨水屏 / e-ink display / desk card / glanceable display / secondary display - set up the device for the first time (flash firmware, pair, provision Wi-Fi) — phrases like "刚拿到 M5Paper", "怎么装卡片", "first-time setup", "刷固件", "卡片没
why_zh: 它把「显示」变成一条语音指令的事，而不是又一轮菜单点击。M5Paper 的硬件细节（分辨率、刷新。
why_en: Turns 'display' into a spoken command, not another menu dive. All M5Paper quirks—resolution, refresh, network—are wrapped, so.
limit_zh: 只认 M5Paper 这一块 540×960 墨水屏，别的 e-ink 设备不适用。内容推上去后不会自动排版。
limit_en: Only works with M5Paper 540×960 e-ink. No auto-layout: long text may overflow, so keep messages short. Other e-ink devices unsupported.
title_en: Remote for your e-ink desk card: just say what to show
